info.title: SpyFu API
info.description: Keyword Research, SEO Rankings for any domain, url, subdomain, path, etc. PPC keywords and ad copy for every website has ever advertised on Google.  Domain stats - organic traffic, number of keywords, ad budget for every website. Find competitors and analyze gaps.

get.description: Returns historical ad variations and copy for a specific domain. This endpoint focuses on ads from a particular advertiser across all their keywords and campaigns, unlike term-based endpoints that focus on specific keywords.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Advertiser'¢s root domain

parameters.name: keywordFilter
parameters.description: Filter down to keywords containing this value

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: Country market to search.  Specifically, this maps to the Google version to query against (google.de for Germany, etc).  Google.com (US) is the default.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort order for ad history results.

x-enumDescriptions.Best: Best performing keywords based on longevity, CPC, and testing frequency
x-enumDescriptions.Worst: Worst performing keywords that were tested and likely dropped

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of ad history records to return per page.

parameters.name: startingRow
parameters.description: Starting row number for pagination.

200.description: Successfully retrieved ad history data for the specified domain. Returns a paginated list of historical ad variations with copy, keywords, and campaign information.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid parameters provided (e.g., invalid domain format, pageSize exceeds maximum, or invalid country code)

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid API credentials or insufficient permissions to access ad history data

500.description: Internal Server Error - A server-side error occurred while processing the request

get.description: Returns historical advertisers and ad variations for a specific keyword. This endpoint focuses on ads that have appeared for a particular keyword, unlike domain-based endpoints that focus on ads from specific advertisers.

parameters.name: term

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: Country market to search.  Specifically, this maps to the Google version to query against (google.de for Germany, etc).  Google.com (US) is the default.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of ad history records to return per page.

parameters.name: startingRow
parameters.description: Starting row number for pagination.

200.description: Successfully retrieved ad history data for the specified keyword. Returns a paginated list of ads that have appeared for this keyword across different advertisers.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid parameters provided (e.g., empty term, pageSize exceeds maximum, or invalid country code)

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid API credentials or insufficient permissions to access ad history data

500.description: Internal Server Error - A server-side error occurred while processing the request

get.description: Returns paid search results (ads) that a domain appears in across Google search. This endpoint reveals the competitive paid landscape to identify advertising opportunities and understand competitor PPC strategies.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Domain to analyze for paid search presence.

parameters.name: includeTerms
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of terms that must be present in the keyword.

parameters.name: includeAnyTerm
parameters.description: Used with includeTerms. If true: match any term (OR). If false: require all terms (AND).

parameters.name: excludeTerms
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of terms to exclude from results (e.g., branded or irrelevant terms).

parameters.name: searchVolume.min
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where monthly search volume (Google) is ≥ this value.

parameters.name: searchVolume.max
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where monthly search volume (Google) is ≤ this value.

parameters.name: adCount.min
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the number of distinct advertisers observed over the last 14 months is ≥ this value.

parameters.name: adCount.max
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the number of distinct advertisers observed over the last 14 months is ≤ this value.

parameters.name: keywordDifficulty.min
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the keyword difficulty score is ≥ this value (0-100; higher = harder to rank).

parameters.name: keywordDifficulty.max
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the keyword difficulty score is ≤ this value (0-100; higher = harder to rank).

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of rows returned.

parameters.name: excludeHomepageKeywords
parameters.description: If true, exclude keywords where the domain/URL's homepage (root domain, e.g., example.com) ranks; if false, include all.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: Country market to search.  Specifically, this maps to the Google domain version to query against (e.g., google.com for US, google.de for Germany, etc.).

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Column to sort results by.

x-enumDescriptions.SearchVolume: Number of searches done this past month on Google (or within selected country). Blended from multiple sources for better snapshot of search activity
x-enumDescriptions.KeywordDifficulty: PPC ranking difficulty score (0-100 scale, higher = more difficult to rank). Based on advertiser competition, cost-per-click, and bid density for paid search results

get.description: Returns detailed search engine results page (SERP) analysis for a specific keyword, showing all domains ranking in positions 1-100. This endpoint provides comprehensive ranking data updated monthly to reveal the competitive landscape for any keyword.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Domain, URL, subdomain, or path to analyze. Accepts full domains (example.com), complete URLs (https://example.com/blog), subdomains (blog.example.com), specific paths (example.com/products/), or individual pages.

parameters.name: includeTerms
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of terms that must be present in the keyword.

parameters.name: includeAnyTerm
parameters.description: Used with includeTerms. If true: match any term (OR). If false: require all terms (AND).

parameters.name: excludeTerms
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of terms to exclude from results (e.g., branded or irrelevant terms).

parameters.name: compareDomain
parameters.description: Domain to compare against when evaluating where it outranks you and where you outrank it.

parameters.name: excludeHomepageKeywords
parameters.description: If true, exclude keywords where the domain/URL's homepage (root domain, e.g., example.com) ranks; if false, include all.

parameters.name: searchVolume.min
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where monthly search volume (Google) is ≥ this value.

parameters.name: searchVolume.max
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where monthly search volume (Google) is ≤ this value.

parameters.name: keywordDifficulty.min
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the keyword difficulty score is ≥ this value (0-100; higher = harder to rank).

parameters.name: keywordDifficulty.max
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the keyword difficulty score is ≤ this value (0-100; higher = harder to rank).

parameters.name: rank.min
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the domain/URL rank position is ≥ this value (1 = best/top organic result).

parameters.name: rank.max
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the domain/URL rank position is ≤ this value (1 = best/top organic result).

parameters.name: rankChange.min
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the domain/URL improved by at least this many positions vs. the previous month (rank_change ≥ value). Positive values mean moved up; negative values mean moved down.

parameters.name: rankChange.max
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the month-over-month rank change is at most this many positions (rank_change ≤ value). Positive values mean moved up; negative values mean moved down.

parameters.name: costPerClick.min
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the average cost per click (CPC) is ≥ this value.

parameters.name: costPerClick.max
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the average cost per click (CPC) is ≤ this value.

parameters.name: costPerClickOption
parameters.description: Match type for CPC filtering. Broad = includes variations/related terms; Exact = exact keyword only; Phrase = contains the keyword phrase in order (with additional words allowed).

x-enumDescriptions.Broad: Includes keyword variations and related terms
x-enumDescriptions.Phrase: Includes the keyword phrase in order with additional words

parameters.name: seoClicksChange.max
parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the month-over-month change in estimated organic clicks is ≤ this value. Positive values indicate click gains; negative values indicate click losses.

parameters.description: Filter to keywords where the mobile search share (%) is ≤ this value (range 0-100).

Basic_Authentication_Token.description:
Basic Authentication is a standard that involves encoding your SPYFU_API_ID:SECRET_KEY into a Base64 string. Your SpyFu API ID and Secret Key can both be found under the Account Settings -> API Usage page. Additionally, you can find the Base64 string has been pre-generated on the same page under Base 64 Key. Finally, this encoded string is sent in the "Authorization" header prefixed with the keyword "Basic":
For example, to authorize as 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:AB12WXYZ the client would send
Authorization: Basic MDAwMDAwMDAtMDAwMC0wMDAwLTAwMDAtMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwOkFCMTJXWFla
